parameters.note: McCloud Reservoir (also known as Lake McCloud, the PG&E impoundment behind McCloud Dam) is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the reservoir itself falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). Note that §7.50(b) lists special regulations for segments of the McCloud River below McCloud Dam (e.g., from McCloud Dam downstream to the confluence of Ladybug Creek); those special stream regulations apply to the river, not to the reservoir.

candidates.summary: Reservoir open all year (general statewide lake regulation; the McCloud River below McCloud Dam, not the reservoir, carries the special §7.50 stream regulations)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists McCloud Reservoir (Region 1, Shasta Co.) for catchable-size McCloud River Redband Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of April-October. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists McCloud Reservoir (Region 1, Shasta Co.) for super-catchable-size McCloud River Redband Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of April-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
